finalText:
**Build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read new name, keep old as fallback |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is now `undefined`, threw | Treat `undefined` as `false` |

The 8 warnings are all `DEP` deprecation notices from the bumped deps. They are hardcoded log lines in `build.js` and point at files that do not exist here.

Next: swap `punycode` and `Buffer()` for real if you want zero warnings.
